item.title: Democrats to hold reorganization
item.description: The Pulaski Virginia Democratic Committee will hold its re-organization meeting on Wednesday, Jan. 7, at 5:30 p.m . at the Charles and Ona B. Free Library in Dublin. Committee officers will be elected at this meeting.
